result.instructions: Tools for HDPhotoHub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my clients have a site with an unpaid balance?"; "List all sites for agent jane@example.com and show their status."; "Show the orders for site 12345 with the total and balance due.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HDPhotoHub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hdphotohub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hdphotohub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hdphotohub_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. hdphotohub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hdphotohub_get_brand
tools.title: Get brand
tools.description: Get the business (brand) the API key belongs to: id and name. API: GET /brand.

tools.name: hdphotohub_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List clients and team members, optionally filtered by email or name. API: GET /users.

tools.name: hdphotohub_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id or email. Pass uid or email. API: GET /user.

tools.name: hdphotohub_list_user_transactions
tools.title: List user transactions
tools.description: List the transactions of a user, optionally within a date range. API: GET /user/transactions.

datefrom.description: Include transactions on and after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

dateto.description: Include transactions on and before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: hdphotohub_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List property sites, filtered by user id, user email or an address search string. API: GET /sites.

uid.description: Only sites of this user id.

email.description: Only sites of the user with this email.

tools.name: hdphotohub_get_site
tools.title: Get a site
tools.description: Get one property site with its status, purchase state, users and all media items (download URL, type, order). API: GET /site.

tools.name: hdphotohub_get_media
tools.title: Get a media item
tools.description: Get one media item (photo, video, floor plan) by id. API: GET /media.

tools.name: hdphotohub_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders, optionally for one site or one user. Orders carry totals, balance due, tasks and payments. API: GET /orders.

sid.description: Only orders of this site id.

uid.description: Only orders of this user id.

tools.name: hdphotohub_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id with tasks, taxes, payments and invoice URL. API: GET /order.

tools.name: hdphotohub_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List groups (brokerages and teams), optionally filtered by name. API: GET /groups.

tools.name: hdphotohub_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Get one group by id. API: GET /group.

tools.name: hdphotohub_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the configured webhooks. API: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: hdphotohub_get_webhook
tools.title: Get a webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook by id. API: GET /webhook.

tools.name: hdphotohub_list_webhook_events
tools.title: List webhook events
tools.description: List the available webhook event types and payload options. API: GET /webhook/events.

tools.name: hdphotohub_create_site
tools.title: Create a site
tools.description: WRITE: create a new property site for a user. Not idempotent: a repeat call creates a second site. API: POST /site.

banner.description: Banner text shown on the property site (for example 'Just Listed').

tools.name: hdphotohub_update_site
tools.title: Update a site
tools.description: WRITE: update fields of an existing property site. Only the fields you pass change. API: PUT /site.

banner.description: Banner text shown on the property site (for example 'Just Listed').

tools.name: hdphotohub_set_site_status
tools.title: Set site status
tools.description: WRITE: set a site to active, inactive or archived. This does not purchase the site. API: PUT /site/status.

tools.name: hdphotohub_set_site_media_order
tools.title: Set media order
tools.description: WRITE: set the sort order of the media of a site. Pass media ids in the wanted order. API: PUT /site/mediaorder.

mid.description: Media ids in the wanted order.

tools.name: hdphotohub_update_media
tools.title: Update a media item
tools.description: WRITE: update name, description, type, visibility, highlight or branding of one media item. API: PUT /media.

tools.name: hdphotohub_upsert_user
tools.title: Create or update a user
tools.description: WRITE: create a user (no uid) or update one (uid or email of an existing user). API: PUT /user.

prompts.title: Get started with HDPhotoHub
prompts.description: What you can do with HDPhotoHub here, with example requests to try.
